title: Hal Puthoff's medieval levitating secret society

tellings.quote: me off and he goes or it could be a medieval secret society that knows how to levitate and they put these metal capsules around them

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, recalls a conversation with Hal Puthoff, a physicist who has long studied UFOs. Michels says Puthoff offered, as one possible explanation for the craft people report, that they could come from a medieval secret society that learned how to levitate and put metal capsules around themselves. If true, UFOs would be the work of a hidden human group rather than visitors from elsewhere.
